label: after-rerun
method: Native Playwright mouse/keyboard/file-input interactions in fresh Chromium contexts; exact persisted states compared with deterministic engine transitions. No UI internals assigned.
limitations: Synthetic fixtures target otherwise lengthy or probabilistic branches; they are not claims of human natural play.
Storage quota and missed-storage-event cases intentionally inject browser faults.
This driver records correctness and screenshots, not frame-rate measurements.
